usedFor: Mobile Text Alerts receives customer texts, and MSG91 Hello logs them when “SMS Reply Received” runs “Send Mail via Hello”.

bestTemplate.name: “SMS Reply Received” in Mobile Text Alerts, then “Send Mail via Hello” in MSG91
bestTemplate.why: A customer reply to a text becomes a Hello ticket, so support picks it up in one place.

watchOut: “Send Mail via Hello” creates a ticket or replies with a ticket id, so a reply needs that id.
